title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
description:
A racing game spanning France and Japan with more than 40 licensed cars, dozens of tracks, a Japanese car-culture story mode, highway traffic races, and extensive mechanical and cosmetic customization.

The career mode moves between France and Japan, emphasizing regional racing cultures and event identity. Japanese roads, tuning culture and vehicle style are especially important to this entry. Progression is built around unlocking faster cars, tougher events and deeper customization options. The overall structure mixes collection, customization and racing progression rather than a character-heavy narrative.
